notes.title: 🧨 Update 0.3 – More Immersion, New Raids & the First Interrior!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’ve been working hard on preparing Update 0.3, and I’m really excited to share what’s coming next for CriminalZ. This update focuses heavily on immersion and introduces the very first playable interrior.

🔊 A More Immersive Experience
To enhance the feel of the world, I’ve been improving the overall player experience — especially during looting. Looting is now more satisfying, thanks to new sound effects and UI feedback. Each item pickup should feel impactful, and it’s now clearer what kind of loot you've found.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/e4b3f7d7d49f895d707a84a1b73070078ad8ef65.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/b524004a16456df47b0669fc574371909c3c7249.png"]

👊 Boss Interface Overhaul
The boss UI has also been redesigned. Before each new stage, players will now receive a short message at the top of the screen telling them what’s changed in the current wave. Every stage is now more challenging — but also more rewarding.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/8b2c2f8d3a5e88d38885fd815a293dc5afbad84b.png"]

🌌 Raid Portals Reworked
I’ve completely changed the portal visuals and sounds. Entering a raid should now feel more like "We’re about to hit this place hard!"
Portals can now spawn in different rarities — and the rarer the portal, the better the loot you’ll find inside. Get ready to hunt for those high-tier raids!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/e2047acdb602aaa1d2545672d214ef54d2d6cdd7.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/3aa7f4c6b96be79120f6c4cb4fa909b3c8745f09.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/a6b2a71a454bd324143481486a8ff735687f75ca.png"]
[hr][/hr]
If you’ve got questions, want to share your ideas, or just hang out with other players, be sure to join our Discord.

https://discord.gg/fh6vPGekTd

I’d love to hear your feedback — it helps me shape the future of the game!

Thanks for all your support. –
CriminalZ Dev
